infotexts.entitydescription.Multi-toolSET: A composite tool; toggle welder/cutter, shine a built-in flashlight beam, enable extinguisher mode, and use a shared oxygen tank.
infotexts.entitydescription.wrenchscrewdrivertwoin: Designed for submarine engineers, double right-click to switch wrenches/screwdrivers.
infotexts.entitydescription.EmergencyServiceNodeSE: Service module for an emergency service detonator. While mounted, it waits for water or fire, then slowly repairs flooded compartments, pumps water, and releases extinguisher bursts using a shared 1-minute charge budget. Recharge it in a battery charger or oxygen refiller.
infotexts.entitydescription.EmergencyServiceDetona: Wall-mounted service detonator for the emergency service node. Bots can keep a fully charged module here and take depleted ones back to chargers.
